endpoints.summary: Verify the user's email address from token
endpoints.rationale: Verifies an email address from a token. Email verification flow; with Roxy's cookie it could bind state to the account.

endpoints.summary: Send verify email to the authenticated user's email address
endpoints.rationale: Sends a verification email to the account's address. Email spam vector tied to the account.

endpoints.summary: Gets the authenticated user's verified email and pending (unverified) email if one exists
endpoints.rationale: Returns the verified email and any pending email. Private identifying data.

endpoints.summary: Signs a user up for Roblox and links the account to the authenticated external provider ID.
endpoints.rationale: Signs a new user up and links an external identity provider. Signup flow; also an abuse vector for mass account creation from Roxy's IP.
endpoints.notes: auth none, but with Roxy's cookie attached the linking could target the logged-in session.

endpoints.summary: Logs in a user to Roblox based on the user's authenticated external provider session
endpoints.rationale: Logs in through an external provider session. Login flows must never pass through Roxy; it could replace or collide with Roxy's session cookie.

endpoints.summary:
Deprecated endpoint
Logins in a user to Roblox, then links the Roblox account to the external provider ID
endpoints.rationale: Deprecated login-then-link flow that ties an external identity to a Roblox account. Login and account-linking flow.
endpoints.notes: Deprecated.

endpoints.summary: Signs a user up for Roblox and links the account to the authenticated external provider ID
endpoints.rationale: Signs a new user up and links an external identity provider. Signup flow; also an abuse vector for mass account creation from Roxy's IP.
endpoints.notes: auth none, but with Roxy's cookie attached the linking could target the logged-in session.

endpoints.summary: Unlink the logged in Roblox account from the current external provider ID
endpoints.rationale: Unlinks the logged-in account from its external provider. Marked auth none, but with Roxy's cookie it acts on Roxy's account.
endpoints.notes: Sneaky: "none" auth that mutates the cookie owner.

endpoints.summary: Reserves a nonce for a native SSO sign-in attempt.
endpoints.rationale: Reserves a nonce for a native SSO sign-in attempt. Part of a login flow.

endpoints.summary: OAuth callback for identity providers that return the authorization code on a GET redirect (Okta, Google).
endpoints.rationale: OAuth callback (GET) that completes an SSO login and sets session cookies. Login/OAuth flow; a forged callback through Roxy could bind or log in sessions.

endpoints.summary:
OAuth callback for identity providers that POST the authorization code as form fields (Apple form_post).
Apple's first-auth `user` JSON is parsed and carried to identity storage; the form
`id_token` is ignored. Web login exchanges code via PKCE and does
not treat a form id_token as proof.
endpoints.rationale: OAuth callback (POST) that completes an SSO login and sets session cookies. Login/OAuth flow; a forged callback through Roxy could bind or log in sessions.

endpoints.summary: Signs a user up for Roblox and links the account to the authenticated external provider ID via OAuth.
endpoints.rationale: Starts an OAuth SSO signup/link flow. Login/signup flow, and with Roxy's cookie the link could target Roxy's account.

endpoints.summary: SAML Assertion Consumer Service endpoint that external identity provider calls post user authentication.
endpoints.rationale: SAML assertion consumer that finishes an SSO login. Login flow; never proxy.

endpoints.summary: Gets the favorite count for the given asset Id.
endpoints.rationale: Returns an asset's favorite count. Public number.

endpoints.summary: Gets the favorite count for the given bundle Id.
endpoints.rationale: Returns a bundle's favorite count. Public number.

endpoints.summary: Delete a favorite for an asset by the authenticated user.
endpoints.rationale: Removes a asset favorite of the authenticated user. Write acting as Roxy's account.
endpoints.notes: Needs CSRF token.

endpoints.summary: Gets the favorite model for the asset and user.
endpoints.rationale: Returns the favorite record for a asset and user; it only answers for the authenticated user, so it reveals what Roxy's account has favorited.
endpoints.notes: Sneaky: looks like a per-user public read but the userId must be the logged-in user.

endpoints.summary: Create a favorite for an asset by the authenticated user.
endpoints.rationale: Favorites a asset as the authenticated user. Write acting as Roxy's account (favorite spam can be abused to inflate counts).
endpoints.notes: Needs CSRF token.

endpoints.summary: Delete favorite for the bundle by the authenticated user.
endpoints.rationale: Removes a bundle favorite of the authenticated user. Write acting as Roxy's account.
endpoints.notes: Needs CSRF token.

endpoints.summary: Gets the favorite model for the bundle and user.
endpoints.rationale: Returns the favorite record for a bundle and user; it only answers for the authenticated user, so it reveals what Roxy's account has favorited.
endpoints.notes: Sneaky: looks like a per-user public read but the userId must be the logged-in user.

endpoints.summary: Create a favorite for the bundle by the authenticated user.
endpoints.rationale: Favorites a bundle as the authenticated user. Write acting as Roxy's account (favorite spam can be abused to inflate counts).
endpoints.notes: Needs CSRF token.

endpoints.summary: Lists the marketplace assets favorited by a given user with the given assetTypeId.
endpoints.rationale: Lists marketplace assets a given user has favorited. Public third-party data.

endpoints.summary: Lists the bundles favorited by a given user with the given bundle subtypeId.Switched to EAAS style pagination cursors since July 2024.
endpoints.rationale: Lists bundles a given user has favorited. Needs login but returns third-party data.
endpoints.notes: With userId = Roxy's account it lists the account's favorites; trivial.

endpoints.summary: Deletes the featured event for a group
endpoints.rationale: Deletes a group's featured event. A write that uses the account's group permissions.

endpoints.summary: Gets the featured event for a group
endpoints.rationale: Reads which event a group is featuring. Public group page data.

endpoints.summary: Sets the featured event for a group
endpoints.rationale: Sets a group's featured event. A write using the account's group permissions, even though auth is listed as optional.
endpoints.notes: Marked cookie-optional but is a write; it can only succeed with a cookie.

endpoints.summary: Get all icons for a game
endpoints.rationale: Lists a game's localized icons with moderation state for the creator UI. Needs edit rights.
endpoints.notes: Public game icons come from thumbnails.roblox.com.

endpoints.summary: Delete a localized icon from a game
endpoints.rationale: Deletes a localized game icon. Write on owned games.

endpoints.summary: Update a game's icon
endpoints.rationale: Uploads a localized game icon. Write plus image moderation risk.

endpoints.summary: Assigns or revokes a role
endpoints.rationale: Assigns or revokes a translator role on a game. Permission change through the account.

endpoints.summary: Retrieves the list of roles granted to current logged-in user
endpoints.rationale: Returns the account's own translator roles on a game. Reveals what the account can act on.
endpoints.notes: "Current user" endpoint.

endpoints.summary: Gets list of users assigned a specific role in a game.
endpoints.rationale: Lists users and groups assigned a translator role on a game. Only visible to the game's owner, so it reads through the account's permissions.

endpoints.summary: Gets the list of games and associated role assignment info for the requested user and role.
endpoints.rationale: Lists games where the account holds a translator role. A "my" endpoint revealing the account's collaborations.

endpoints.summary:
Gets the language translation counts for the specified table.
The languages to retrieve must be provided.
endpoints.rationale: Returns translation progress counts for games in a language. Creator dashboard data that needs permissions on the games.

endpoints.summary: Gets the language translation counts for all languages of a game
endpoints.rationale: Returns translation progress counts for all languages of a game. Creator dashboard data.

endpoints.summary: Thumbnails game pass icons.
endpoints.rationale: Returns game pass icon URLs. Public image data.
endpoints.notes: Thumbnail state can be Pending; cache Completed results longer than Pending ones.

endpoints.summary: Update localized description of a game pass
endpoints.rationale: Updates the localized description of a game pass. Write on items the account may own.

endpoints.summary: Get all icons for a game pass
endpoints.rationale: Lists localized icons of a game pass, including moderation state. A creator tool read that needs edit rights.
endpoints.notes: Public icons come from thumbnails.roblox.com instead.

endpoints.summary: Delete a localized icon from a game pass
endpoints.rationale: Deletes a localized icon of a game pass. Write on items the account may own.

endpoints.summary: Update a game pass's icon
endpoints.rationale: Uploads a localized icon for a game pass. Write plus image moderation risk.

endpoints.summary: Get all names and descriptions of a game pass
endpoints.rationale: Lists all localized names and descriptions of a game pass for the creator UI. Needs edit rights.
endpoints.notes: Public localized names come from the normal item endpoints.

endpoints.summary: Delete localized name and description of a game pass
endpoints.rationale: Deletes a localized name and description of a game pass. Write on owned items.

endpoints.summary: Update localized name and description of a game pass
endpoints.rationale: Updates a localized name and description of a game pass. Write on owned items.

endpoints.summary: Update localized name of a game pass
endpoints.rationale: Updates the localized name of a game pass. Write on owned items.

endpoints.summary:
The server will call this on game server start to request general information about the universe
This is version 1.1, which returns an entry from the UniverseAvatarType enum.
During mixed mode this may return unreliable results.
endpoints.rationale: Returns a universe's avatar settings (R6/R15, scale limits, asset overrides). Public per-universe config used by game servers.
endpoints.notes: Response varies by universeId only; safe to cache.

endpoints.summary: Get the localized image ids in all languages for a game.
endpoints.rationale: Returns localized thumbnail image ids for a game in all languages. Public data, no auth.

endpoints.summary: Updates the game thumbnail alt text.
endpoints.rationale: Updates a game thumbnail's alt text. Write on owned games.

endpoints.summary: Uploads the game thumbnail.
endpoints.rationale: Uploads a localized game thumbnail. Write plus image moderation risk.

endpoints.summary: Orders the specified image Ids for the game thumbnails.
endpoints.rationale: Reorders a game's localized thumbnails. Write on owned games.

endpoints.summary: Deletes the game thumbnail.
endpoints.rationale: Deletes a localized game thumbnail. Write on owned games.

endpoints.summary: Gets a list of games' detail
endpoints.rationale: Returns game details (name, creator, playing, visits, price) for universe ids. Core public data that games rely on.
endpoints.notes: Has isFavoritedByUser, which reflects Roxy's account. Trivial since favorite writes are blocked, and it is the same for every caller so caching is fine.

endpoints.summary: Gets a list of games' product info, used to purchase a game
endpoints.rationale: Returns purchase info (for sale, price, product id) for paid-access games. Public data.

endpoints.summary:
Fetches game icon URLs for a list of universes' root places. Ids that do not correspond to a valid universe will be filtered out.
The ordering of the results is not guaranteed to be the same as the inputs. In order to correlated inputs with outputs please
use the 'targetId' of the objects in the result array.
endpoints.rationale: Returns game icon URLs for universe ids. Heavily used. Public image data.
endpoints.notes: Thumbnail state can be Pending; cache Completed results longer than Pending ones.

endpoints.summary: Get place details
endpoints.rationale: Returns place details for place ids. Public data, but cookie-required, so it needs the token.
endpoints.notes: isPlayable and reasonProhibited reflect the account (age, region). Same answer for every caller.

endpoints.summary: Gets a list of universe playability statuses for the authenticated user
endpoints.rationale: Returns whether universes are playable "for the authenticated user". Works anonymously; with the cookie it reveals the account's own restrictions (age, verification, parental controls) in the reason fields.
endpoints.notes: Viewer-relative by design. Anon gives a guest answer that is generic and safe to cache.

endpoints.summary: Fetch game thumbnail URLs for a list of universe IDs.
endpoints.rationale: Returns game thumbnail URLs for several universes. Public image data.
endpoints.notes: Thumbnail state can be Pending; cache Completed results longer than Pending ones.

endpoints.summary: Get games recommendations based on a given universe
endpoints.rationale: Returns games similar to a given universe. Public discovery data.
endpoints.notes: May include sponsored entries and light personalization; nothing private.

endpoints.rationale: Buys a new private server in a universe. Spends the account's Robux and starts a subscription.
endpoints.notes: Spending endpoint. Never allow.

endpoints.rationale: Returns up and down vote counts for several universes. Public data.

endpoints.summary: Uploads a game thumbnail.
endpoints.rationale: Uploads a game thumbnail image. Write on a universe the account may own or edit, plus moderation risk from uploaded images.
Lists private servers in a place that the account owns or has access to, including access codes and player lists.
endpoints.notes: Sneaky: looks like a server list, but every row is account-relative and accessCode lets someone join.

endpoints.rationale: Lists live servers of a place (players, ping, fps). Heavily used public data when serverType is 0 (Public).
endpoints.notes: serverType 1 (Friend) lists servers where the account's friends play, which is social data. Add a path rule that refuses serverType 1 or "Friend". Short cache only, data changes by the second.

endpoints.summary: Returns if a game was marked as favorite for the authenticated user
endpoints.rationale: Returns whether Roxy's account has favorited a game. Pure account-relative data with no public value.

endpoints.summary: Favors (or unfavors) a game for the authenticated user
endpoints.rationale: Favorites or unfavorites a game as the account. A write that could be spammed to manipulate rankings and get the account flagged.
endpoints.notes: Write, needs CSRF.

endpoints.summary: Get the favorites count of a specific game.
endpoints.rationale: Returns how many users favorited a game. Public data.

endpoints.summary: Get the game media data
endpoints.rationale: Returns a game's images and videos. Public data.
endpoints.notes: Deprecated, v2 replaces it.

endpoints.summary: Fetches game thumbnail URLs for a list of universes' thumbnail ids. Ids that do not correspond to a valid thumbnail will be filtered out.
endpoints.rationale: Returns specific thumbnails of a game. Public image data.
endpoints.notes: Thumbnail state can be Pending; cache Completed results longer than Pending ones.

endpoints.rationale: Casts the account's up or down vote on a game. A write that could be spammed to manipulate ratings and flag the account.
endpoints.notes: Write, needs CSRF.

endpoints.rationale: Returns up and down vote counts for one universe. Public data.
Returns the account's own vote on a game and whether it can vote (the reason reveals play history). Account-relative data.
endpoints.notes: Sneaky: path looks like a vote count read.

endpoints.summary: Gets a page of templates that can be used to start off making games.
endpoints.rationale: Lists Roblox's starter game templates. Public static data.

endpoints.summary: Get the user's gender
endpoints.rationale: Returns Roxy's own gender setting. Private account data.
endpoints.notes: Deprecated.

endpoints.summary: Update the user's gender
endpoints.rationale: Updates Roxy's gender setting. Account write.
endpoints.notes: Deprecated.

endpoints.summary: Get the user's gender
endpoints.rationale: Returns the account's own gender setting. Private account data with no userId param.

endpoints.summary: Update the user's gender
endpoints.rationale: Changes the account's gender setting.

endpoints.summary: Gets Group configuration contextual information
endpoints.rationale: Returns static group configuration limits (name lengths, costs, role limits). Same for everyone.

endpoints.summary: Creates a new group.
endpoints.rationale: Creates a group and charges the account Robux for it.
endpoints.notes: Spends Robux; also uploads icon files.

endpoints.summary: Updates the group icon.
endpoints.rationale: Changes a group's icon using the account's permissions. Image upload abuse vector.

endpoints.summary: Fetches thumbnail URLs for a list of groups. Ids that do not correspond to groups will be filtered out.
endpoints.rationale: Returns group icon URLs. Public image data.
endpoints.notes: Thumbnail state can be Pending; cache Completed results longer than Pending ones.

endpoints.summary:
Gets Groups contextual information:
Max number of groups a user can be part of.
Current number of groups a user is a member of.
Whether to show/hide certain features based on device type.
endpoints.rationale: Returns group display options plus the viewer's current group count and limit. With the cookie, currentGroupCount describes Roxy's account.
endpoints.notes: Response varies by viewer. Anonymous gives the generic limits, which is all a caller needs.

endpoints.summary: Gets group policy info used for compliance.
endpoints.rationale: Batch lookup (POST used as a read) of whether groups can be viewed under the viewer's compliance policy. Returns only canViewGroup flags.
endpoints.notes: Requires login. Result can vary by the account's region/policy, so cached answers reflect Roxy's account policy (trivial).

endpoints.summary: Search for groups by keyword.
endpoints.rationale: Keyword search over public groups.
endpoints.notes: Results could be personalized slightly; generally the same for everyone.

endpoints.summary: Looks up groups by a name. Prioritizes an exact match as the first result.
endpoints.rationale: Looks up groups by exact name. Public data and a common game use (group name to id).

endpoints.summary: Get suggested groups and other miscellaneous information needed for the group/join page like flags
endpoints.rationale: Suggested search keywords and a flag for the group search page.
endpoints.notes: Docs say it may be personalized in the future; switch to ALLOW_ANON if that happens.

endpoints.summary: Gets group information
endpoints.rationale: Gets public group details (name, owner, member count, shout). One of the most used group reads.
endpoints.notes: The shout can be hidden from non-members by group settings, so it varies by viewer membership. Safe as long as Roxy's account is in no groups (it cannot join through Roxy since joins are blocked).

endpoints.summary: Gets the Group's audit log
endpoints.rationale: Returns a group's audit log, which only admins with permission can read. Would expose anything the account can see through its own group roles.
endpoints.notes: Member/admin-gated data (goal d).

endpoints.summary: Gets the bans for the group
endpoints.rationale: Lists users banned from a group. Admin-only data gated by the account's group permissions.

endpoints.summary: Unbans a user from a group
endpoints.rationale: Unbans a user from a group using the account's permissions.

endpoints.summary: Fetch the group ban of a user from a group
endpoints.rationale: Reads one user's ban record in a group. Admin-gated moderation data.

endpoints.summary: Bans a user from a group
endpoints.rationale: Bans a user from a group using the account's permissions.

endpoints.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of blocked keywords for a specific Group.
endpoints.rationale: Lists a group's blocked chat/wall keywords. Admin-only configuration data.

endpoints.summary: Adds new blocked keyword(s) to the specified Group.
endpoints.rationale: Adds blocked keywords to a group. Admin write.

endpoints.summary: Deletes a specific blocked keyword from the specified Group.
endpoints.rationale: Deletes a group's blocked keyword. Admin write.

endpoints.summary: Updates an existing blocked keyword for the specified Group.
endpoints.rationale: Edits a group's blocked keyword. Admin write.

endpoints.summary: Changes the group owner to another user.
endpoints.rationale: Transfers group ownership to another user. Irreversible owner action.

endpoints.summary: Claims ownership of the group as the authenticated user
endpoints.rationale: Claims ownership of an ownerless group as the account. A state change that ties the account to a group.

endpoints.summary: Gets the freeze status of the community features for a group.
endpoints.rationale: Reads whether a group's community features are frozen. Public status flags.
Triggers a re-evaluation of a group's community tier. A write action using the account.
endpoints.notes: No summary in the spec; POST that changes or recomputes server state.

endpoints.summary: Gets group configuration information
endpoints.rationale: Returns a group's emblem and cover photo ids. Public display data.
endpoints.notes: If it ever returns more for group admins, revisit.

endpoints.summary: Deactivates the group as its owner.
endpoints.rationale: Deactivates a group as its owner. Destructive owner action.

endpoints.summary: Updates the groups description
endpoints.rationale: Updates a group's description. Admin write that can post text as the account.

endpoints.summary: Gets a groups emote sets.
endpoints.rationale: Gets a group's emote sets, which are tied to group membership/chat. Gated by the account's membership.
endpoints.notes: Unsure if this is fully public; low value to games either way.

endpoints.summary: Gets the freeze status of all features and the lock status for a group.
endpoints.rationale: Reads the lock state and feature freezes of a group. Public status flags.

endpoints.summary:
Sets the desired status of group features.
Currently only removes active freezes for features set to Roblox.Groups.Api.FeatureStatus.On.
endpoints.rationale: Changes group feature status (removes freezes). Admin write.

endpoints.summary:
Checks whether a group has ANY feature disabled (includes feature freezes and group lock).
Used to display a banner on Creator Hub/Studio to inform group members that some features may not be available.
endpoints.rationale: Returns one boolean: whether a group has any feature disabled. Public banner data.

endpoints.summary: Batch declines group join requests
endpoints.rationale: Batch declines group join requests. Admin write.

endpoints.summary: Gets a page of Group Join Requests for a group.
endpoints.rationale: Lists pending join requests for a group. Admin-only data that leaks through the account's permissions.

endpoints.summary: Batch accepts group join requests
endpoints.rationale: Batch accepts group join requests. Admin write.

endpoints.summary: Declines/cancels a group join request.
endpoints.rationale: Declines or cancels a join request. For the account itself this cancels its own pending request.

endpoints.summary: Gets a group join request by userId.
endpoints.rationale: Reads one user's join request. Admin-gated, or the account's own pending request.

endpoints.summary: Accepts a group join request.
endpoints.rationale: Accepts a group join request. Admin write.

endpoints.summary: Gets group membership information in the context of the authenticated user
endpoints.rationale: Returns the authenticated account's membership and role in a group, including its own user id and permissions. Reveals who the account is.
endpoints.notes: Sneaky: looks like a public group read but it is entirely about the viewer.

endpoints.summary: Updates the group's name.
endpoints.rationale: Renames a group and charges the account Robux.

endpoints.summary: Gets the Group's name change history.
endpoints.rationale: Lists a group's previous names. Public history.

endpoints.summary: Updates the group's settings
endpoints.rationale: Changes the account's notification preference for a group. A write to the account's settings.

endpoints.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the group can use payout feature
endpoints.rationale: Tells whether a group can use payouts. Finance-admin data gated by the account's permissions.

endpoints.summary: Gets a list of the group payout percentages
endpoints.rationale: Lists a group's recurring payout percentages. Finance data only readable with group funds permissions.

endpoints.summary: Pays out a user in Robux.
endpoints.rationale: Pays out Robux from group funds to a user. Moves money.

endpoints.summary: Gets the latest one-time payout for each requested user.
endpoints.rationale: Gets the latest one-time payout per requested user for a group. Listed as cookie-optional with 'Public' response models, so the public view is served without the cookie.
endpoints.notes: If the cookie were attached and the account had funds permissions, it might reveal more. Unclear how much anonymous gets; it is finance data, so BLOCK is a reasonable alternative.

endpoints.summary: Updates recurring payouts.
endpoints.rationale: Replaces a group's recurring payout list. Moves money and removes recipients.

endpoints.summary: Gets suggested one-time payouts for eligible collaborators.
endpoints.rationale: Suggested one-time payouts for collaborators of a group. Cookie-optional; served without the cookie so the account's group permissions never apply.
endpoints.notes: Looks like an admin-facing helper; BLOCK would also be defensible.

endpoints.summary: Gets payout-visible universes for a group.
endpoints.rationale: Lists universes and payout percentages visible for a group. Cookie-optional; strip the cookie so the account's permissions cannot widen the result.
endpoints.notes: Finance-related; consider BLOCK if the public view is empty anyway.

endpoints.summary: Gets a group's relationships
endpoints.rationale: Lists a group's public allies or enemies. Public group data.

endpoints.summary: Deletes a group relationship.
endpoints.rationale: Deletes a group relationship. Admin write.

endpoints.summary: Gets a group's relationship requests
endpoints.rationale: Lists pending ally/enemy requests for a group. Admin-only data.

endpoints.summary: Create a group relationship.
endpoints.rationale: Sends a group relationship request. Admin write.

endpoints.summary: Declines a group relationship request.
endpoints.rationale: Declines a group relationship request. Admin write.

endpoints.summary: Accepts a group relationship request.
endpoints.rationale: Accepts a group relationship request. Admin write.

endpoints.summary: Deletes a group relationship.
endpoints.rationale: Removes an ally or enemy relationship. Admin write.

endpoints.summary: Create a group relationship.
endpoints.rationale: Creates an ally or enemy request. Admin write.
Returns a group's Robux revenue summary; only works for members with finance rights, so it would expose finances of any group the account can manage.
endpoints.notes: Category could also be group-actions / creator-private-data.

endpoints.summary: Gets a list of the rolesets in a group.
endpoints.rationale: Lists a group's roles (name, rank, member count). The main group roles read used by games.
endpoints.notes: Sneaky param: includePrivate=true returns private roles only to members. Safe while the account is in no groups; if it ever joins one, this becomes a membership leak. Consider stripping includePrivate.

endpoints.summary: Gets the permissions for a group's guest roleset. These can be viewed by all (members and guests) users.
endpoints.rationale: Permissions of a group's guest role, which the docs say anyone can view.

endpoints.summary: Gets all permissions for each role
endpoints.rationale: Gets the permissions of every role. Only owners/admins can read it, so it works only through the account's own group powers.

endpoints.summary: Gets the permissions for a group's roleset. The authorized user must either be the group owner or the roleset being requested, except for guest roles, which can be viewed by all (members and guests).
endpoints.rationale: Gets permissions for one role; the caller must be owner or in that role. Would reveal the account's own role permissions.

endpoints.summary: Updates the permissions for a group's roleset. The authorized user must be the group owner.
endpoints.rationale: Changes permissions of a group role as owner. Security-sensitive admin write.

endpoints.summary: Gets a list of users in a group for a specific roleset.
endpoints.rationale: Lists users in a specific role of a group. Public member list for non-private roles.
endpoints.notes: Private roles answer only to members; same caveat as the roles list.

endpoints.summary: Creates new group roleset.
endpoints.rationale: Creates a group role (may cost Robux). Admin write.
endpoints.notes: Role creation has a Robux cost per roleConfiguration.cost.

endpoints.summary: Deletes existing group roleset.
endpoints.rationale: Deletes a group role. Admin write.

endpoints.summary: Updates existing group roleset.
endpoints.rationale: Updates a group role. Admin write.

endpoints.summary: Gets the Group's settings
endpoints.rationale: Reads a group's admin settings. Only managers can read it.

endpoints.summary: Updates the group's settings
endpoints.rationale: Changes a group's settings. Admin write.

endpoints.summary: Get social link data associated with a group
endpoints.rationale: Reads the social links shown on a group page. Visible to everyone on the website even though the API wants a login.
endpoints.notes: Requires login, so the cookie is what makes it work.

endpoints.summary: Posts a social links
endpoints.rationale: Adds a social link to a group. Admin write and a link-spam vector.

endpoints.summary: Deletes a social link
endpoints.rationale: Deletes a group social link. Admin write.

endpoints.summary: Updates a social link
endpoints.rationale: Edits a group social link. Admin write and a link-spam vector.

endpoints.summary: Gets a list of universes for the given group.
endpoints.rationale: Lists a group's universes. Public anonymously; with the cookie, Roblox may also include private or archived universes the account can see through group permissions.
endpoints.notes: Anon so a group the account belongs to cannot have its private games listed through Roxy. Cache is then the same for every caller.

endpoints.summary: Gets a list of users in a group.
endpoints.rationale: Lists members of a group. Public data.

endpoints.summary: Joins a group
endpoints.rationale: Joins a group as the account. A state change that could also make the account a member and open membership leaks elsewhere.
endpoints.notes: Keeping this blocked is what keeps the group read endpoints safe.

endpoints.summary: Removes a user from a group
endpoints.rationale: Kicks a user from a group, or makes the account leave when userId is its own id.

endpoints.summary: Updates a users role in a group.
endpoints.rationale: Changes a member's role. Admin write.

endpoints.summary: Gets the permissions a user has in a group. Only available to group owner and RCC
endpoints.rationale: Gets a user's permissions in a group; only available to the owner. With the cookie it answers for the account's own id or groups it owns.
endpoints.notes: Sneaky: cookie-optional but useful only with owner rights. No public use.

endpoints.summary: Endpoint for login with identity verification
endpoints.rationale: Login using an identity verification result. Login flow.

endpoints.summary: Initiates identifier-first login flow by returning a list of login methods for user(s).
endpoints.rationale: Identifier-first login: returns available login methods for the account(s) behind an identifier. Login flow and account enumeration vector.

endpoints.summary: Get information about which CDNs to use for installation.
endpoints.rationale: Lists which CDNs the installer should use. Public static info.
endpoints.notes: No auth needed; the cookie adds nothing. Cache freely, changes only on client deploys.

endpoints.summary: Get list of Supported locales with user locus information.
endpoints.rationale: Returns supported locales with flags for where each is enabled. Public reference data.

endpoints.summary: Sets whether translations suggested by Roblox will be shown to the user.
endpoints.rationale: Changes whether Roblox-suggested translations are shown to the account. A settings write.

endpoints.summary:
Sets user's supported locale.
Null supported locale will clear out user's supported locale (set users' supported locale to null)
endpoints.rationale: Changes the account's language. A settings write that would also change the language of later cached responses.
endpoints.notes: Sneaky side effect: other endpoints localize by account locale, so this would alter what every caller sees.

endpoints.summary: Get list of supported locales sorted by the Native Name property.
endpoints.rationale: Returns all supported locales. Public reference data.
Returns locales supported for creators. Public reference data.

endpoints.summary: Get list of Supported locales for a specific feature.
endpoints.rationale: Returns locales supported for a named feature. Public reference data.

endpoints.summary: Gets user locale. If user is absent returns, locale from http request object.
endpoints.rationale: Returns the user locale; without a login it uses the request's own locale. With the cookie it returns the account's saved language.
endpoints.notes: Anon gives the caller-relative answer, which is the useful one for a proxy. Varies by Accept-Language, so key the cache on it or skip caching.

endpoints.summary:
Gets each of a user's localization locus supported locales. A localization locus supported locale is a page (or group of pages) that
have been defined by the International team which need independent locale support.
If the user is null we will attempt to return the locales appropriate for the user's device language.
endpoints.rationale: Returns the locale used for each area (signup, experiences, UGC). With the cookie it describes the account's settings; anon it uses the request.
endpoints.notes: Same as user-locale: varies by request headers.

endpoints.summary: Get limits for translation table entries operations
endpoints.rationale: Returns size limits for table entry operations. Static config.

endpoints.summary: Get metadata for localization UI
endpoints.rationale: Returns feature flags for the localization table UI. Static config.

endpoints.summary:
Creates a Localization Table with the given data.
Note that this endpoint simply creates a table and does not associate it with any universe, so if intending to use this to create tables usable in experience more setup will be needed to grant those experiences access.
endpoints.rationale: Creates a localization table asset as the account. Creates content under the account.

endpoints.summary: Get table information by the assetId of the table.
endpoints.rationale: Returns a localization table by its asset id. A creator tool read that needs access to the table.
endpoints.notes: Games read translations in-engine via LocalizationService, not through this API.

endpoints.summary: Get table information by the id of the table.
endpoints.rationale: Returns a localization table by table id. A creator tool read that needs access to the table.
endpoints.notes: Games read translations in-engine via LocalizationService, not through this API.

endpoints.summary: Updates the tables contents based on what is provided.
endpoints.rationale: Updates a localization table's entries and translations. Write on tables the account owns or translates.

endpoints.summary:
Gets a page of asset (image) entries for the specified table, along with the table's
per-locale asset translations.
endpoints.rationale: Returns image entries and per-locale translation status for a table. Creator data behind table access.
endpoints.notes: Games read translations in-engine via LocalizationService, not through this API.

endpoints.summary: Gets a batch of entries for a table.
endpoints.rationale: Returns a page of entries and translations from a table. Creator data that may include unreleased game text.
endpoints.notes: Games read translations in-engine via LocalizationService, not through this API.

endpoints.summary: Gets the translation feedback for each entry passed in.
endpoints.rationale: Returns translation feedback for entries (a POST read). Creator data behind table access.

endpoints.summary: Gets the translation history for each entry passed in.
endpoints.rationale: Returns translation history for entries, including translator info (a POST read). Creator data behind table access.

endpoints.summary: Gets the number of entries in the specified table
endpoints.rationale: Returns the number of entries in a table. Creator data behind table access.
endpoints.notes: Games read translations in-engine via LocalizationService, not through this API.

endpoints.rationale: Updates a game's localization table. Write on games the account may own or translate.

endpoints.summary: Authenticates a user.
endpoints.rationale: Authenticates a user with credentials and sets a new session cookie. Would turn Roxy into a credential-stuffing relay and could disturb Roxy's own session.
endpoints.notes: Critical. Also a captcha and ban magnet.

endpoints.summary:
Endpoint for logging in a user, specifically for linked
authentication on PCGDK
endpoints.rationale: Linked-authentication login for PCGDK (Xbox PC). Login flow.

endpoints.summary: Destroys the current authentication session.
endpoints.rationale: Destroys the current session. With Roxy's cookie attached any caller could log Roxy out and kill the proxy's authenticated mode.
endpoints.notes: Critical sneaky endpoint: cookie-optional, kills the attached session.

endpoints.summary: Logs out user from all other sessions.
endpoints.rationale: Logs out every other session and issues a new cookie, rotating Roxy's .ROBLOSECURITY. The new cookie would go back to the caller, handing them a live session.
endpoints.notes: Critical: session rotation plus credential leak in the Set-Cookie response.

endpoints.summary: Retrieves an asset by its mar (moderation agnostic) hash and mar (moderation agnostic) checksum.
endpoints.rationale: Downloads an asset's file by moderation-agnostic hash and checksum. Heavily used for public assets, but with Roxy's cookie it would also hand out private or copylocked assets the account is allowed to access, so forward without the cookie.
endpoints.notes: Permissions leak: with the cookie, Roblox serves any asset Roxy's account can access (its own or group-owned private models, audio, packages, copylocked places it can edit, assets shared to it through asset permissions). Strip the cookie and any caller-sent Roblox-Place-Id/permissionContext style headers should not grant extra access. If Roblox starts refusing anonymous downloads (401), only flip to ALLOW_TOKEN after confirming the account owns, edits and is shared on nothing private. Responses are redirects/locations to signed CDN URLs that expire; cache per asset id plus version for a short time only.

endpoints.summary: Gets a user's messages.
endpoints.rationale: Returns the account's private messages.

endpoints.summary: Archives a batch of messages.
endpoints.rationale: Archives the account's messages. Write to the inbox.

endpoints.summary: Marks a batch of messages as read.
endpoints.rationale: Marks the account's messages as read. Write to the inbox.

endpoints.summary: Marks a batch of messages as unread.
endpoints.rationale: Marks the account's messages as unread. Write to the inbox.

endpoints.summary: Unarchives a batch of messages.
endpoints.rationale: Unarchives the account's messages. Write to the inbox.

endpoints.summary: Gets unread messages for the authenticated user.
endpoints.rationale: Unread message count for the authenticated account.

endpoints.summary: Gets a message's details.
endpoints.rationale: Reads one private message by id from the account's inbox.

endpoints.summary: Get the metadata
endpoints.rationale: Site feature flags for account information pages (phone enabled, max description length). Harmless config; strip the cookie because a few flags may depend on the account.
endpoints.notes: Low value.

endpoints.summary: Get the metadata
endpoints.rationale: Auth site feature flags (isUpdateUsernameEnabled, passkey enabled, ftux avatar map). Harmless config, forward without the cookie.
endpoints.notes: Some flags may be account-relative with a cookie, hence anon.

endpoints.rationale: Friends page metadata (feature flags plus userName/displayName for targetUserId). With the cookie, flags are per-account experiments and the name fields may describe the viewer.
endpoints.notes: Sneaky: response includes userName/displayName; if targetUserId is omitted it may return the account's own name. Strip the cookie. BLOCK would also be fine, it has little value.

endpoints.summary: Gets two step verification system metadata.
endpoints.rationale: 2SV system metadata, but with a cookie or userId it adds maskedUserEmail, isUserU13 and whether 2SV is enabled. Leaks identifying and security data about Roxy or the target user.
endpoints.notes: Sneaky: looks like harmless metadata, carries masked email.

endpoints.summary: Get mobile client version information based on app version parameter
endpoints.rationale: Returns mobile client version info for an app version. Public deployment info.
endpoints.notes: No auth needed; the cookie adds nothing. Cache freely, changes only on client deploys.

endpoints.summary: Get the number of friends a user has
endpoints.rationale: The account's own friend count (the 'my' variant).
endpoints.notes: Use /v1/users/{userId}/friends/count for anyone.

endpoints.rationale: Refreshes the account's QR friend-add session, which lets someone scanning a code become its friend.

endpoints.summary: Get all users that friend requests with targetUserId using exclusive start paging
endpoints.rationale: Lists incoming friend requests to the account, revealing who is contacting it.
Checks a QR friending session for the account. Part of the QR add-friend flow.
Count of new friend requests to the account.

endpoints.summary: Get all incoming trusted friend requests using exclusive start paging.
endpoints.rationale: Lists incoming trusted-friend requests to the account.

endpoints.summary: Gets the history for name or description in a provided language.
endpoints.rationale: Returns the edit history of a game's localized name or description, including translator identities. A POST read that needs permissions on the game.

endpoints.summary: Gets a game's name and description in all supported languages
endpoints.rationale: Returns a game's name and description in all supported languages. Public data, no auth.

endpoints.summary: Updates a game's name and/or description in multiple languages.
endpoints.rationale: Updates a game's name and description in several languages. Write on owned games.

endpoints.summary: Rollout settings for name/description migration to new page
endpoints.rationale: Returns rollout settings for the name and description editor. Static config.
endpoints.notes: May vary by rollout bucket; trivial.

endpoints.summary: Deletes the outfit.
endpoints.rationale: Deletes one of the authenticated user's outfits. Destructive write on Roxy's account.
endpoints.notes: Needs CSRF token. Irreversible.

endpoints.summary: Gets details about the contents of an outfit.
endpoints.rationale: Returns the contents of an outfit by id (v1). Outfits are public data addressed by id, so the cookie only helps rate limits.
endpoints.notes: Deprecated, use v4.

endpoints.summary: Given a package ID, returns the list of asset IDs for that package
endpoints.rationale: Lists asset ids inside a legacy package. Public data.
endpoints.notes: Deprecated; packages moved to bundles.

endpoints.summary: Disables a batch of credentials for the specified user.
endpoints.rationale: Disables passkeys on the account. Security setting write on Roxy's account.

endpoints.summary: Complete Passkey registration by providing credential creation options.
endpoints.rationale: Completes passkey registration. A caller could register their own passkey on Roxy's account and take it over.
endpoints.notes: Critical: takeover vector.

endpoints.summary: List a user's registered passkeys.
endpoints.rationale: Lists the account's registered passkeys. Private security data (POST that is a read, but of the account itself).

endpoints.summary: Rename a credential for the specified user.
endpoints.rationale: Renames a passkey on the account. Security setting write.

endpoints.summary: Provides a challenge for the Passkey to authenticate.
endpoints.rationale: Issues a passkey login challenge. Login flow.

endpoints.summary: Initiates Passkey registration by providing credential creation options.
endpoints.rationale: Starts passkey registration for the logged-in account. First half of adding an attacker passkey.

endpoints.summary:
Finishes account recovery pre-auth passkey registration by validating the recovery session,
deactivating the user's password, and completing passkey registration.
endpoints.rationale: Finishes account-recovery passkey registration from a recovery session. Recovery flow.
Finishes pre-authenticated passkey registration. Credential registration flow.

endpoints.summary: Initializes passkey authentication for the user(s) corresponding to the identifier provided.
endpoints.rationale: Starts passkey login for the accounts behind an identifier and returns a sessionId. Login flow.

endpoints.summary: Initiates  Passkey preauthenticated registration by providing credential creation options.
endpoints.rationale: Starts pre-authenticated passkey registration. Credential registration flow.

endpoints.summary:
Checks whether the authenticated user is eligible for silent passkey upgrade.
Route and response are intentionally obfuscated ("su-eligibility" = "silent-upgrade-eligibility").
endpoints.rationale: Whether the authenticated user can get a silent passkey upgrade. Account-relative security state.

endpoints.summary: Endpoint for checking if a password is valid.
endpoints.rationale: Checks a username/password pair against password rules. The password travels in the query string, so it would sit in Roxy logs and cache keys.
endpoints.notes: Never forward secrets in URLs through a shared cache.

endpoints.summary: Endpoint for checking if a password is valid.
endpoints.rationale: Password strength check for a username/password pair. Part of the password/signup flow; Roxy should not be a relay for passwords.

endpoints.summary: Get Verified Phone Number
endpoints.rationale: Returns Roxy's verified phone number. Private identifying data.

endpoints.summary: Set Phone Number
endpoints.rationale: Sets the account phone number. A caller could attach their own phone and use it for recovery and takeover.
endpoints.notes: Takeover vector.

endpoints.summary: Delete Phone
endpoints.rationale: Removes the phone from Roxy's account. Security write.

endpoints.summary: Resend Phone code
endpoints.rationale: Resends the phone verification code. SMS spam vector tied to the account.

endpoints.summary: Verify Phone
endpoints.rationale: Verifies a phone code, finishing phone attachment. Completes a takeover-capable flow.

endpoints.summary: Fetches game icon URLs for a list of places. Ids that do not correspond to a valid place will be filtered out.
endpoints.rationale: Returns game icon URLs for place ids. Public image data.
endpoints.notes: Thumbnail state can be Pending; cache Completed results longer than Pending ones.

endpoints.summary: Updates the place configuration for the place with the id placeId
endpoints.rationale: Updates a place's configuration (name, description, max players). Write on places the account may own or edit.
endpoints.notes: Write, needs CSRF.

endpoints.summary: Updates the place configuration for the place with the id placeId
endpoints.rationale: Updates a place's configuration (POST alias of the PATCH). Write on places the account may own or edit.
endpoints.notes: Write, needs CSRF.

endpoints.summary: List of users in the active Team Create session
endpoints.rationale: Lists users in a place's live Team Create session. Only works when the account has edit access, so it reads through the account's permissions.

endpoints.summary: Gets plugin details by ids.
endpoints.rationale: Returns public details for plugins by id. Public catalog data.

endpoints.summary: Updates a plugin.
endpoints.rationale: Updates a plugin's name, description or comment setting. Write on plugins the account owns.
endpoints.notes: Write, needs CSRF.

endpoints.summary: Overwrites a plugin icon with a new one.
endpoints.rationale: Overwrites a plugin icon with an uploaded image. Write on assets the account owns, plus moderation risk.
Changes or removes the account's (or a group's) asset publishing preferences. Settings write.
endpoints.notes: Needs CSRF token.

endpoints.rationale: Reads the account's (or a group's) publishing preferences. Account-private settings.
Changes or removes the account's (or a group's) asset publishing preferences. Settings write.
endpoints.notes: Needs CSRF token.

endpoints.rationale: Changes or removes the account's (or a group's) asset publishing preferences. Settings write.
endpoints.notes: Needs CSRF token.

endpoints.rationale: Batch presence lookup for a list of user ids (POST used as a read). Very common game use.
endpoints.notes: Response varies by viewer: location/placeId depends on each target's privacy relative to the viewer. Roxy's account has no friends, so it sees roughly the public view. Cache per request body; do not mix with any other viewer's results.

endpoints.rationale: Returns whether private servers are enabled for a universe. Public game setting.
Lists private servers the account owns or joined. Private data with join info.
endpoints.notes: "My" endpoint.

endpoints.summary: Get the user's promotion channels
endpoints.rationale: Returns the authenticated account's own social links. "My" endpoint that reveals Roxy's account; use the by-userId version instead.

endpoints.summary: Update the user's promotion channels
endpoints.rationale: Updates Roxy's social links. Profile write and a spam/phishing link vector.
Same public server list via the newer server browser path. Public data for serverType 0.
endpoints.notes: serverType 1 (Friend) lists servers where the account's friends play, which is social data. Add a path rule that refuses serverType 1 or "Friend". Short cache only, data changes by the second.

endpoints.summary: Get metadata for forgot endpoints
endpoints.rationale: Static flags for the forgot-password/username pages (code length, phone features). Harmless config, forward without the cookie.
endpoints.notes: Low value.

endpoints.summary: Resizes larger thumbnails to specified size and format
endpoints.rationale: Resizes an existing thumbnail by content hash. Public image data; the cookie is irrelevant.
endpoints.notes: Immutable per hash, cache aggressively.

endpoints.summary: Get Revert Account ticket info
endpoints.rationale: Reads info for an account-revert (security recovery) ticket. Ticket flow, may reveal account details for the ticket holder.

endpoints.summary: Submit Revert Account Request
endpoints.rationale: Submits an account revert request using a ticket (resets password, email, sessions). Account recovery flow.

endpoints.summary:
Invalidates all account security tickets for the authenticated user.
This endpoint should be called before enrolling in EPP to ensure old revert links cannot be used.
endpoints.rationale: Invalidates all account security tickets for the authenticated user. Acts on Roxy's account security state.

endpoints.summary: Gets the Roles by their ids.
endpoints.rationale: Batch lookup of group roles by role id.
endpoints.notes: includePrivate param: same member-only caveat as /v1/groups/{groupId}/roles.

endpoints.summary: Decrypts and Resizes larger thumbnails to specified size and format
endpoints.rationale: Decrypts and resizes a signed thumbnail URL. Public image data; access is controlled by the thumbprint, not the cookie.
endpoints.notes: Immutable per hash, cache aggressively.

endpoints.summary: Logs out user from the current session and create a new one.
endpoints.rationale: Logs out the current session and creates a new one. Rotates Roxy's cookie and returns the fresh cookie to whoever called.
endpoints.notes: Critical: Set-Cookie with a valid session would leak to the caller and the stored cookie becomes invalid.

endpoints.summary: Endpoint for signing up a new user
endpoints.rationale: Creates a new Roblox account. Signup flow and mass account creation abuse vector; with a cookie present it may also replace the session.

endpoints.summary: Endpoint for signing up a new user through linked authentication.
endpoints.rationale: Signup through linked authentication. Signup flow.

endpoints.summary: Get social network user information if the given social auth method is connected to current user.
endpoints.rationale: Lists social login providers connected to Roxy's account with the linked external user info. Private identifying data.

endpoints.summary: Removes the given social authentication method from current Roblox user if it is connected.
endpoints.rationale: Removes a social sign-in method from the account. Security write on Roxy's account.

endpoints.summary: Gets the source language of a game
endpoints.rationale: Returns a game's source language. Public data, no auth.

endpoints.summary: Sets the source language of a game
endpoints.rationale: Sets a game's source language. Write on owned games.

endpoints.summary: Gets the source language of a game
endpoints.rationale: Returns a game's source language with locales. Public data, no auth.

endpoints.summary: Records clicks for sponsored games.
endpoints.rationale: Records a click on a sponsored game as the account. Same click fraud risk as the ad click tracker.
endpoints.notes: Write, needs CSRF.

endpoints.summary: Retrieves sponsored pages to serve to a user on a specific device type in a specific country.
endpoints.rationale: Returns sponsored pages chosen for the logged-in user on a device and country. No proxy use, and serving ads to the account may log impressions.
endpoints.notes: Response is personalized to the account. Harmless if allowed, but has no value for game servers.

endpoints.summary: Returns the asset information for creating a new sponsored campaign.
endpoints.rationale: Returns setup info for starting a paid ad campaign on an item, which only works for items the account owns or manages. Part of the ad buying flow.
endpoints.notes: Reveals whether the account can sponsor a given asset.

endpoints.summary: Lists Subcategory Names and their Ids.
endpoints.rationale: Lists catalog subcategory names and ids.

endpoints.summary: Get the supported languages for a game.
endpoints.rationale: Returns the languages a game supports. Public data games may want.

endpoints.summary: Add or remove supported languages for a game.
endpoints.rationale: Adds or removes supported languages for a game. Write on owned games.

endpoints.summary: Get the automatic translation status of supported languages for a game.
endpoints.rationale: Returns automatic translation status per language for a game. Creator setting that needs permissions on the game.

endpoints.summary: Get the user's in-experience language selector languages for a game.
endpoints.rationale: Returns the languages offered in a game's in-experience language picker. Game-level list with nothing about the account.
endpoints.notes: Cookie-required but the response is a plain language list.

endpoints.summary: Enable or disable automatic translation for a game and language.
endpoints.rationale: Turns automatic translation on or off for a game language. Write on owned games that also uses translation quota.

endpoints.summary: Enable or disable image translation for a game and language.
endpoints.rationale: Turns image translation on or off for a game language. Write on owned games.

endpoints.summary: Update the switch which controls if the UniverseDisplayInformation should be automatically translated.
endpoints.rationale: Changes whether a game's display info is auto-translated. Write on owned games.

endpoints.summary: Get UniverseDisplayInfo automatic translation settings.
endpoints.rationale: Returns a game's display info auto-translation settings. Creator setting that needs permissions on the game.

endpoints.summary: Rollout settings for supported languages of a game
endpoints.rationale: Returns rollout settings for the supported languages feature. Static config.
endpoints.notes: May vary by rollout bucket; trivial.

endpoints.summary: returns all the enabled theme types.
endpoints.rationale: Lists the enabled site theme names (Light, Dark). Harmless constant list; the cookie is not needed.
endpoints.notes: Very low value.

endpoints.summary: returns the theme type for a specific consumer.
endpoints.rationale: Returns the theme setting for a consumer (the user). Only works for the authenticated account, so it reads Roxy's settings.

endpoints.summary: Modify the theme type for consumer.
endpoints.rationale: Changes the account theme. Minor, but still a settings write on Roxy's account.

endpoints.summary:
Gets topics for a populated request, or trending queries when the request has no topic inputs.
Topics and queries are mutually exclusive in the response.
endpoints.rationale: Returns suggested search topics or trending queries for marketplace search. POST is only a read.
endpoints.notes: May be lightly personalized for a logged-in viewer; low value either way.

endpoints.summary: Get a user's trade privacy setting
endpoints.rationale: Returns Roxy's trade privacy setting. Private account setting.

endpoints.summary: Updates a user's trade privacy setting
endpoints.rationale: Changes who can trade with Roxy's account. Opening trades invites trade spam and scams aimed at the account.

endpoints.summary: Get a user's trade quality filter setting
endpoints.rationale: Returns Roxy's trade quality filter setting. Private account setting.

endpoints.summary: Updates a user's trade quality filter setting
endpoints.rationale: Changes the trade quality filter. Settings write.

endpoints.summary:
Deprecated. TradeSession are automatically set to expire while the inbound/outbound trades are fetched.
Expires Outdated Inbound Trades for User
endpoints.rationale: Expires the authenticated user's outdated inbound trades. Write on the account's trades.
endpoints.notes: Deprecated. Needs CSRF token.

endpoints.summary: Gets metadata about the trade system.
endpoints.rationale: Returns global trade system constants (max items, fee, value ratio). No account data despite needing login.

endpoints.summary: Sends a trade.
endpoints.rationale: Sends a trade offer from Roxy's account. Moves items and Robux and is a scam/spam vector.
endpoints.notes: Needs CSRF token.

endpoints.summary: Gets detailed information about a trade.
endpoints.rationale: Returns details of a trade the authenticated user is part of. Private account trades.

endpoints.summary: Accepts a trade.
endpoints.rationale: Accepts a trade as Roxy's account, transferring items. Irreversible.
endpoints.notes: Needs CSRF token.

endpoints.summary: Counters a trade.
endpoints.rationale: Counters a trade as Roxy's account. Trade action involving items and Robux.
endpoints.notes: Needs CSRF token.

endpoints.summary: Declines a trade.
endpoints.rationale: Declines a trade as Roxy's account.
endpoints.notes: Needs CSRF token.

endpoints.summary: Fetches a list of the authenticated user's trades.
endpoints.rationale: Lists the authenticated user's inbound/outbound/completed trades. Private account data.

endpoints.summary:
Gets the total number of pending trades for the authenticated user.
Inbound is the only accepted tradeStatusType.
endpoints.rationale: Counts the authenticated user's pending inbound trades. Private account data.

endpoints.summary: Download translation analytics report after the report is ready
endpoints.rationale: Downloads a translation analytics report for a game. Private creator analytics.

endpoints.summary: Request translation analytics report to be generated
endpoints.rationale: Requests generation of a translation analytics report for a game. Creator analytics, needs permissions on the game.
endpoints.notes: Triggers server-side work; abuse vector if spammed.

endpoints.summary: Get metadata related to UI and rollout settings
endpoints.rationale: Returns UI and rollout settings for translation analytics. Static config.

endpoints.summary: Get ui configurations for frontend to use.
endpoints.rationale: Returns feature flags for the localization UI (game products, badge icons enabled). Static config.

endpoints.summary: Gets a list of universes.
endpoints.rationale: Returns basic info (name, creator, privacy, root place) for several universes. Public data, no auth needed.
endpoints.notes: The audiences field is universe-level, not viewer-relative.

endpoints.summary: Returns an array of granted and declined permissions related to the universes with the ids in ids for the authenticated user.
endpoints.rationale: Returns which permissions the authenticated account has on given universes. Probes what the account can manage.
endpoints.notes: Sneaky: harmless-looking batch read, but every field is about the account.

endpoints.summary: Gets TeamCreate settings for multiple universes specified by Ids
endpoints.rationale: Returns Team Create settings for universes. Needs edit access, so it reads through the account's permissions.

endpoints.summary: Returns the result of various checks for a user's eligibility to publish a public universe
endpoints.rationale: Returns the account's own eligibility checks to publish a public game (verification and similar). Private account status.
endpoints.notes: No params at all: the answer is entirely about Roxy's account.

endpoints.summary: Gets a Roblox.Api.Develop.Models.UniverseModel.
endpoints.rationale: Returns basic info for one universe. Public data, no auth needed.

endpoints.summary: Activates a universes.
endpoints.rationale: Makes a universe public (active). Changes the visibility of games the account owns or manages.
endpoints.notes: Write, needs CSRF.

endpoints.summary: Returns the result of various checks for a user's eligibility to activate a given universe from private to public universeId for authenticated user
endpoints.rationale: Returns whether the account may activate a given universe. Account-relative permission check.

endpoints.summary: Gets badges by their awarding game.
endpoints.rationale: Lists the badges of a game. Public data, heavily used.

endpoints.summary: Creates a new badge.
endpoints.rationale: Creates a new badge in a universe and charges the selected payment source (Robux). Spends money and acts with the account's creator permissions.
endpoints.notes: Also economy-spend.

endpoints.summary: Get settings for an owned universe.
endpoints.rationale: Returns full settings of a universe the account owns or edits (price, access, permissions). Private creator settings.

endpoints.summary: Update universe settings for an owned universe.
endpoints.rationale: Updates settings of an owned universe, including price and access. Write on the account's games.
endpoints.notes: Write, needs CSRF. Price changes are economy-relevant.

endpoints.summary: Remove playtesters from an owned universe.
endpoints.rationale: Removes playtesters from an owned universe. Write on the account's games.

endpoints.summary: Get the list of playtesters for an owned universe.
endpoints.rationale: Lists playtesters of an owned universe. Private creator data visible only with edit rights.

endpoints.summary: Add playtesters to an owned universe. Existing ids are ignored (additive union).

endpoints.summary: Get user player choice settings for universe.

endpoints.summary: Get user localization settings for universe.

endpoints.summary: Return the number of pending friend requests.

endpoints.notes: "My" endpoint with no params.

endpoints.summary: Return the number of pending trusted friend requests.

endpoints.summary: Checks if a username is valid.

endpoints.summary: Get users by ids.

endpoints.summary: Gets the age bracket of the authenticated user.

endpoints.summary: Get Avatar Busts for the given CSV of userIds

endpoints.notes: Thumbnail state can be Pending; cache Completed results longer than Pending ones.

endpoints.summary: Get Avatar Headshots for the given CSV of userIds

endpoints.notes: Thumbnail state can be Pending; cache Completed results longer than Pending ones.

endpoints.summary: Get 3d object for an outfit
endpoints.rationale: Returns 3D data for an outfit. Public image data.
endpoints.notes: Needs login; returns public render data, the cookie only satisfies auth.

endpoints.summary: Get outfits for the given CSV of userOutfitIds

endpoints.notes: Thumbnail state can be Pending; cache Completed results longer than Pending ones.

endpoints.summary: Searches for users by keyword.
endpoints.rationale: Searches users by keyword. Public data.
endpoints.notes: Results may rank the viewer's friends higher, so they can vary slightly by viewer; Roxy's account has no friends. Heavily rate limited.

endpoints.summary: Creates the following between a user and user with targetUserId
endpoints.rationale: Makes the account follow a user. Spammy write that could flag the account.

endpoints.summary: Get the number of following a user has

endpoints.summary: Get all users that user with targetUserId is following in page response format
endpoints.rationale: Lists who any user follows. Public list, requires login.
endpoints.notes: Items include presence fields that may vary by viewer.

endpoints.summary: Get the number of following a user has
endpoints.rationale: Following count for any user. Public.

endpoints.rationale: Makes the account unfollow a user. A write as the account.

endpoints.summary: Gets detailed user information by id.
endpoints.rationale: Gets public profile info for a user id. Very common game use.

endpoints.summary: Gets all collectible assets owned by the specified user.

endpoints.rationale: Returns the inventory category list for a user. Mostly static UI data.

endpoints.summary: Get list of all friends for the specified user.

endpoints.summary: Get a paginated list of all friends for the specified user.
endpoints.rationale: Paginated friend list of any user. Public.

endpoints.summary: Gets a list of all groups the specified users' friends are in.

endpoints.summary: Get list of inactive friends for the specified user.

endpoints.summary: Get list of all online friends for the specified user.

endpoints.rationale: Downloads an asset's file by id, version or hash query params (v2 returns location JSON with content representations). Heavily used for public assets, but with Roxy's cookie it would also hand out private or copylocked assets the account is allowed to access, so forward without the cookie.
endpoints.notes: Permissions leak: with the cookie, Roblox serves any asset Roxy's account can access (its own or group-owned private models, audio, packages, copylocked places it can edit, assets shared to it through asset permissions). Strip the cookie and any caller-sent Roblox-Place-Id/permissionContext style headers should not grant extra access. If Roblox starts refusing anonymous downloads (401), only flip to ALLOW_TOKEN after confirming the account owns, edits and is shared on nothing private. Responses are redirects/locations to signed CDN URLs that expire; cache per asset id plus version for a short time only.

endpoints.rationale: Same as v1: only cookieLawNoticeTimeout. Harmless config, forward without the cookie.

endpoints.summary: Sets the authenticated user's body colors.

endpoints.summary: Sets the avatar's current assets to the list.

endpoints.summary: Returns details about a specified user's avatar.

endpoints.summary: Gets a list of outfits for the specified user.

endpoints.summary: Gets experiences created by the specified group id.

endpoints.rationale: Completes a login after 2-step verification and issues a session. Login flow.

endpoints.summary: Gets the currently wearing avatar definition for the authenticated user.
endpoints.rationale: Returns the currently worn avatar definition of the authenticated user, which is always Roxy's account.
endpoints.notes: Use GET /v4/avatar/users/{userId} for public avatars.

endpoints.summary: Sets the avatar to the incoming avatar using field masks.
endpoints.rationale: Sets the authenticated user's whole avatar using field masks (v4). This changes Roxy's account.
endpoints.notes: Needs CSRF token.

endpoints.summary: Gets the currently wearing avatar definition for the specified user.
endpoints.rationale: Returns the currently worn avatar definition for a given user. Heavily used public read. Public data for any userId.

endpoints.summary: Creates a new outfit.
endpoints.rationale: Creates an outfit on the authenticated user's account. This changes Roxy's account.
endpoints.notes: Needs CSRF token.

endpoints.summary: Updates the contents of an outfit.
endpoints.rationale: Updates the contents of one of the account's outfits. This changes Roxy's account.
endpoints.notes: Needs CSRF token.

endpoints.summary: Gets the definition for an outfit.
endpoints.rationale: Returns the definition of an outfit by id (v4). Outfits are public data addressed by id, so the cookie only helps rate limits.
endpoints.notes: checkAssetAvailability (where present) is evaluated for the viewer, so availability flags may reflect Roxy's account; trivial.

endpoints.summary:
Permanently delete an existing game event. Returns 204 No Content on success.
Permission is enforced via an explicit pre-check: callers that can read but not edit
receive 403; callers that cannot read receive 404.
endpoints.rationale: Permanently deletes a game event. Accepts only an API key or OAuth, which Roxy does not have and callers may not send, so it can never work through Roxy.

endpoints.summary:
Get a single game event by ID.
Use `?fields=` to request a subset of fields; unknown field names return 400.
endpoints.rationale: Reads one game event (virtual event) by id. Accepts only an API key or OAuth, which Roxy does not have and callers may not send, so it can never work through Roxy.

endpoints.summary:
Partially update a game event. Only fields present in the request body are changed; omitted or null fields are left
unchanged. Empty body is a no-op and returns the current game event resource.
endpoints.rationale: Partially updates a game event. Accepts only an API key or OAuth, which Roxy does not have and callers may not send, so it can never work through Roxy.

endpoints.summary:
List game events under a universe.
Use `?fields=` to trim the response payload.
Response is always 200 (empty list for unknown universe).
endpoints.rationale: Lists game events of a universe. Accepts only an API key or OAuth, which Roxy does not have and callers may not send, so it can never work through Roxy.

endpoints.summary: Create a new game event. Returns the full resource on success.
endpoints.rationale: Creates a game event in a universe. Accepts only an API key or OAuth, which Roxy does not have and callers may not send, so it can never work through Roxy.
endpoints.notes: Spam and ban risk.
